items.what: Directories must load only files ending in .conf, ignoring other files (e.g. .conf.disabled)
Files within a directory are loaded in sorted (alphabetical) order so later overrides earlier deterministically

reason: The instruction's 'pick up the config snippets inside it' doesn't specify the .conf-only filter (a new filtering criterion the conf2.d test enforces), which is not inferable; sorted ordering is implied by the 00-/10- example naming and is guessable.
